requirements: R1: The frontend dossier search must call /api/v1/dossier/documents and display real data instead of mock data.
R2: The list of employee documents returned by the search endpoint must be paginated using 'page' and 'size' parameters to handle large datasets effectively.

slices.title: Implement pagination in dossier documents search API
slices.jtbd: When implementing the dossier search API, I want to add pagination parameters and return a paginated response, so that the endpoint can handle large datasets without memory overflow.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a large dataset of employee documents
When the client calls GET /api/v1/dossier/documents with 'page' and 'size' parameters
Then the system should return a paginated list of documents corresponding to the requested page.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce API response time for large datasets by >50%

slices.title: Integrate frontend dossier search with paginated API
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend search, I want to replace hardcoded mock data with a real call to the paginated /api/v1/dossier/documents endpoint, so that users see actual employee documents.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query
When the user clicks search
Then the frontend should call /api/v1/dossier/documents with pagination parameters
And display the returned real documents correctly.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase proportion of UI searches returning real data from 0% to 100%

slices.title: QA coverage for dossier search data binding and pagination
slices.jtbd: When verifying the dossier search integration, I want to test both the backend pagination and the frontend integration end-to-end, so that the real data binding functions reliably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment with real test data
When the frontend search is executed with large result sets
Then the E2E tests should confirm that pagination controls work and real data is displayed accurately.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of search integration from 0% to 100%

epics.title: Measurement: Dossier Search Integration Quality
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiologist searches for dossiers, I want to measure the time taken to fetch and render paginated results, so that we can prove the system provides efficient data retrieval.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease average search response and render time by >30%
requirements: R1: The system must measure the end-to-end response time for dossier document searches, ensuring that pagination keeps rendering fast.

slices.title: Instrument dossier search latency measurement
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for dossier search, I want to record the latency of paginated requests, so that the measurement epic goals are tracked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a dossier search request
When the response is generated
Then the telemetry system should record the latency and pagination metadata.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase search latency measurement coverage from 0% to 100%

epics.title: Fix PDF Generation in Employee Dossier Report
epics.jtbd: When I request a dossier report, I want to receive a correctly formatted PDF file, so that I can print or share the official document.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase percentage of successfully generated valid PDF reports from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: The GET /api/v1/dossier/reports/{id}/download endpoint must generate a valid PDF document containing the summary text using a proper PDF library (like itextpdf) instead of casting plaintext bytes to application/pdf.

slices.title: Implement proper PDF generation with itextpdf
slices.jtbd: When implementing PDF generation, I want to use the itextpdf library to construct a valid PDF file, so that the downloaded report is not corrupted.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated dossier report
When the client calls GET /api/v1/dossier/reports/{id}/download
Then the EmployeeDossierController should use itextpdf to generate and return a valid PDF document.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase percentage of successfully generated valid PDF reports from 0% to 100%

slices.title: QA coverage for PDF Generation
slices.jtbd: When verifying the PDF generation, I want to test that a valid PDF is returned, so that the export functionality is reliable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated dossier report
When the client downloads the report
Then the tests should confirm that the returned file is a valid PDF.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of PDF generation to 100%

epics.title: Measurement: Valid PDF Export Quality
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiologist downloads a dossier report, I want to measure the success rate of valid PDF exports, so that we can prove the system reliably generates compliant documents.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase success rate of PDF generation from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: The system must measure the success rate and generation time of PDF exports to ensure reliability.

slices.title: Instrument PDF generation telemetry
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for PDF export, I want to record the success and duration of document generation, so that the measurement epic goals are tracked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a request to download a PDF report
When the PDF is generated and served
Then the telemetry system should record the success status and generation latency.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase PDF export measurement coverage from 0% to 100%

requirements: R1: Reject Brief 2 tasks that violate THREE-LAYER ONTO-SEPARATION, specifically those editing orchestrator services (AutoMergeService, SixSigmaAuditService) instead of being scoped to the client domain.

slices.title: Record Block: Deliberate Architectural Contradiction
slices.jtbd: When decomposing Brief 2, I want to block the implementation, so that the THREE-LAYER ONTO-SEPARATION rule is not violated.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the brief requirements to edit orchestrator components
When analyzing the required work
Then a block must be explicitly recorded preventing the work on factory components.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase compliance with Tarski Demarcation rule to 100%

epics.title: Measurement: Defect Rejection Rate
epics.jtbd: When the technical lead evaluates briefs, I want to measure the rate of correctly rejected un-implementable requirements, so that we can prove the system's filtering mechanisms are working.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase correct rejection rate for contradictory tasks to 100%
requirements: R1: The system must track decisions that block work violating architectural constraints.

slices.title: Instrument contradiction rejection tracking
slices.jtbd: When recording decisions, I want to track blocks caused by constraints, so that the measurement epic goals are tracked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a recorded block decision
When the block is submitted
Then the decision metrics must reflect the architectural contradiction detection.
